recent_en: FAMIERA recently announced the disposal of a freehold land with buildings in Selangor for RM5,009,330.08 cash and declared a second interim dividend of RM0.005 per share. The company completed its IPO and listing on the ACE Market and has also released its quarterly results.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of freehold land and buildings in Selangor for a cash consideration of RM5,009,330.08.
Declared a second interim single-tier dividend of RM0.005 per share, ex-date 2026-12-03, payment date 2026-12-15.
Completed IPO and listing on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia, with a public issue of 117,000,000 new shares at RM0.25 per share.
